fusions.name: Dead Weight
fusions.desc: Hurls a heavy blow at a target up to 5 tiles away that deals 14 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and knocks it back 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Final Argument
fusions.desc: A blow that deals 32 damage as a guaranteed critical hit, consuming every affliction on the target and adding their remaining damage to the hit.

fusions.name: Planted Feet
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Follow-Through
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, your physical damage rises 30% for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
